description:
Replace the current deployment-manager visual-validation placeholder with a real validation-and-review path tied to desktop release approval.

The finished flow should let operators:
- launch or attach visual validation for built desktop artifacts
- inspect stored validation records and video evidence
- approve or reject from the review flow
- link review outcomes to the canonical deployment approval state instead of leaving validation as a disconnected warning step
name: deployment-manager-visual-validation-approval-flow
title: Turn Visual Validation Into A Real Approval Flow
